meta.window: 2026-08-22 to 2026-11-19 (last 90 days, includes part of 19 Nov)

sources.sales: ShopifyQL FROM sales GROUP BY product_id, product_title (gross_sales, discounts, sales_reversals, net_sales, orders, quantity_ordered, net_items_sold)
sources.landing: ShopifyQL FROM sessions WHERE human_or_bot_session=human AND landing_page_type=Product GROUP BY landing_page_path

field_notes.sessions_with_cart_additions: null: Shopify does not attribute cart additions to a product; see landing_sessions_with_cart_additions (session-level, landing-page based).
field_notes.checkouts: null: not attributable per product in ShopifyQL.
field_notes.refunds: sales_reversals (returns/cancellation reversals) in GBP, negative = money reversed.
field_notes.ad_cost: null: no product-level ad cost (no product report / utm_content yet).
field_notes.contribution: null: product, delivery and payment costs unknown.

classification_rules.buying intent: landing cart sessions >= 5 and landing cart rate >= 8%
classification_rules.high abandonment: (landing checkouts >= 3 and completed/reached < 50%) or (landing cart sessions >= 10, 0 landing completions, net_units <= 1)

meta.labels: VERIFIED (pulled 19 Nov 2026). ad_cost and contribution UNKNOWN.
